items.label: Energy-Saving
items.value: TBOSW Outdoor lights Comes with 15+1 S14 shatterproof Edison bulbs, 2700K delivering high brightness while boasting energy-saving features. Compared to traditional bulbs, it effectively reduces electricity costs, providing sufficient illumination for daily use or party scenarios, combining practicality and economy.

items.label: IP65 Waterproof
items.value: Featuring IP65 waterproof certification, these TBOSW 50Ft string lights can withstand various outdoor conditions such as rain, snow, sun exposure, humidity, and extreme temperatures. Equipped with a durable cable and insulated design, they maintain stable performance for long-term use both indoors and outdoors, making them versatile weatherproof patio lights.

items.label: Smart Control & Flexible Dimmable
items.value: Comes with a remote control for convenient operation of light on/off, brightness adjustment, and custom timing settings without manual handling. You can easily set auto-on/off schedules via the remote, ensuring the lights turn on/off automatically according to your daily routine or event needs. Each bulb works independently, so if one fails, others remain functional, enhancing usability.

items.label: Easy Installation & Expandable Design
items.value: These LED bulbs Built-in loops or hanging structures allow easy installation via hooks, guide wires, or zip ties. Supports end-to-end connection, enabling flexible expansion according to space size to cover different lighting areas. The installation process is simple and efficient, suitable for quick setup of hanging string lights.

items.label: Wide Scene Adaptability
items.value: Thanks to its waterproof, durable, and expandable features, it’s TBOSW outdoor lights perfect for various indoor and outdoor settings, Gazebo Porch, including patio, backyard, garden, balcony, cafe, bistro, Christmas party, and wedding. It adds a cozy ambiance to family gatherings and elevates the style of commercial venues, making it a versatile choice for outdoor patio lights and event decorations.
